messages.text: Hi, can you refund a stainless toaster I bought on another store's website last week, and also refund my ceramic butter dish from my order here delivered 35 days ago? What does your refund policy cover?

messages.text:
Our policy covers items bought by the signed-in customer from this fictional demo shop—not purchases from other stores—so I can’t refund the stainless toaster. (refund-policy/v2/scope)

For your ceramic butter dish, our records show it was received back, as required. (refund-policy/v2/return) However, its refund deadline was November 11, 2026, at 10:00 UTC, and no earlier on-time proposal exists. I therefore can’t refund it: requests must be made within 30 days of delivery. (refund-policy/v2/window)

Generally, eligible refunds cover the amount paid for returned items, minus their discount share, excluding shipping. Each unit can be refunded only once, to the original payment, with confirmation using the proposal-card button and staff approval. (refund-policy/v2/amount) (refund-policy/v2/remaining) (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/approval)
